regime: Korea risk-on close / global neutral-to-risk-off premarket

items.reason: The catalyst is verified and company-specific, but the 30% one-day extension makes immediate entry unattractive
items.risk: Limit-up gap reversal, earnings expectation already priced, policy and polysilicon-cycle risk
items.applied_strategy_rule: Stocks up 18% or more intraday are pullback/retest only
